# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes go into the development branch, `main`, and the next release. Only the
latest release is supported; there are no fixes for older ones.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest release (currently `v0.6.0`) and `main` | :white_check_mark: |
| Older releases | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in CronosDB, please do NOT report it by opening a public issue.

Instead, report it privately through GitHub: [Security → Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/jatin711-debug/cronos_db_golang/security/advisories/new).

Please provide a detailed description of the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce it if possible. We will try our best to address the issue within a reasonable timeframe.
